description: Actions of the U-Chrom web browser. One definition for every caller: the GUI's action layer (frontend/src/actions.ts), WebMCP tools registered by the page, and the Python client (uchrom_browser.connect()). Cells are referred to by cell_id; groups by a group reference: 'field:<column>=<value>' (e.g. field:cell_type=Bergmann), a registered id 'g…', or 'all'.

tools.name: describe_workspace
tools.description: What the browser shows now: the active dataset (path, cells, cell fields, embeddings, tracks, contact maps), open views, the focused cell or group, the lasso selection and saved groups.

tools.name: get_selection
tools.description: The cells the researcher selected: the current lasso selection, else the focused group, else the focused cell. Returns {cells, group, name, source} (cells empty when nothing is selected).

tools.name: select_cells
tools.description: Select cells (like a lasso) and focus them in every view that follows the focus. With `name`, also save the selection as a named group. Returns the group reference.

tools.name: list_groups
tools.description: Groups available as view scopes: automatic groups (one per value of each categorical cell field) and saved groups, with their references and sizes.

tools.name: focus
tools.description: Focus one cell or one group in every view that follows the focus (the 3-D view flies there, others fade). Neither → release the focus (all cells).

tools.name: set_locus
tools.description: Set the genomic window shared by the Genome, Matrix and Stats views.

tools.name: open_view
tools.description: Open a new view (pane) and make it active. `cells`: 'focus' (default: follow the focus), 'all', a cell id or a group reference. Genome views take `rows` (top to bottom): {kind:'track', track, cells?} or {kind:'distance', cells?, stat?} or {kind:'contacts', source, cells?, ratio_to?, smooth?} (ratio_to: a group or 'all' -> log2 of this map over that group's, each over its total; smooth: odd pixels summed, default 3) or {kind:'intervals', key}. Stats views take `stats` (rg | scaling | hist | scatter), `compare_groups` (group references overlaid), `field_x` / `field_y` (cell fields for hist / scatter). Embedding views take `embedding` (a cellm key). Spatial views (cells in the tissue, over its image) take `spatial` (a cell-position set), `region` and `image_opacity`. Returns {pane}.

source.description: matrix view: a contact-map key or 'distance'

spatial.description: spatial view: a cell-position set key (default: the first, sets with images first)

region.description: spatial view: the region (section / FOV) shown (default: the first)

image_opacity.description: spatial view: opacity of the region's image, 0-1 (0 hides it)

tools.name: show_view
tools.description: Make a view the active one (in the tabs layout, the one shown).

tools.name: close_view
tools.description: Close a view by its pane id.

tools.name: arrange
tools.description: Lay the views out as tabs, columns, rows or a grid.

tools.name: color_by
tools.description: Colour all cells by a cell field (e.g. cell_type, rna.Nanog, if.H3K9me3).

tools.name: capture_view
tools.description: Render one view (default: the active one) as PNG; returns {png_base64, width, height, filename}.
